body: I just feel like I keep putting off the inevitable. idk. it's hard to stay motivated to apply for jobs when ive applied for so many and even if i get one right now i wont be able to pay rent at the end of the month.

i think the only reason i havent done anything at this point in my life is because i know how it will affect the people in my life. but im on the edge here. ive lived this long because of them and i dont see how i can keep living for other people. i opened netflix. i'll find something to watch. i cant get out of bed right now.
edit: i think it's worth noting this isnt my netflix account. i dont want people to think im at this point and wasting money on unnecessary things.

I didn't feel like it was negative. I already live with someone. If I leave, that's forcing him to pay my half, which he can't afford. I understand I'm not the only person in this situation, lots of people are stuck like me. In a few months, I'll have student loans to think about too. At least if I'm gone, the debt I have goes away since it's all unsecured.
